validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: real, current, correctly-classified FERC-jurisdictional offshore natural-gas transmission pipeline. Independently confirmed by: (1) FERC/DOE Federal Register notice, Docket Nos. CP96-790-000/-791-000/-792-000, 61 FR 51440 (govinfo.gov, 1996-10-02) -- Nautilus Pipeline Company, L.L.C. applied for a Sec.7(c) certificate to build ~101 mi of 30-in pipe from Ship Shoal Block 207 to Exxon's Garden City Gas Processing Plant, St. Mary Parish, LA, 600,000 Mcfd firm capacity, ~$121M (1996$); (2) FERC Federal Register notice, 62 FR 42114 (govinfo.gov, 1997-08-05) -- the Commission's March 26, 1997 order (78 FERC P61,325) issued the certificate, and Nautilus filed its compliance tariff July 17, 1997; (3) FERC notice 62 FR 44118 (govinfo.gov, 1997-08-19) -- by August 1997 Nautilus was live and requesting new delivery points to 8 interstate/intrastate pipelines near Garden City -- confirms operating status was reached in 1997; (4) Genesis Energy LP SEC 8-K exhibit filed 2026-02-24 -- lists 'Nautilus Pipeline Company, L.L.C., a Delaware limited liability company' as a current, existing Joint Venture Entity/subsidiary as of that date -- i.e. this is not a stale or phantom entity, it is legally live in 2026; (5) Enbridge's own 'Energy Infrastructure Assets' factsheet, last updated 2026-07-28 -- lists Nautilus as an operational current asset (30-in, FERC-regulated offshore gas transmission, Green Canyon Corridor); (6) Wikipedia 'Nautilus Pipeline' stub -- independently confirms it is an Enbridge-owned gas pipeline gathering GoM gas into Louisiana, FERC code 159; (7) Oil & Gas Journal, 'Group slates gas pipeline system in central gulf' (1996-07-15) -- contemporaneous trade-press announcement of the same 30-in/Ship Shoal Block 207/600 MMcfd project by Marathon, Shell and DeepTech (Leviathan) affiliates, expected in service 3Q1997. Classification is correct: this is a transmission trunk (not a gathering line) -- FERC itself calls it a natural-gas transmission pipeline and it interconnects at its terminus with 6-8 downstream interstate/intrastate systems (Koch Gateway, Louisiana Intrastate Gas, Acadian, Cypress Gas, Texas Gas, ANR, Columbia Gulf, Southern Natural Gas per the 1997 notice). No duplicate on the 50-row roster: no other row shares its diameter+capacity+corridor (Ship Shoal Block 207 / Green Canyon Corridor -> Garden City / St. Mary Parish); P0217 Mississippi Canyon and P0192 Garden Banks are physically distinct corridors and pipe (confirmed via the same Enbridge factsheet, see cross_row_leads). FuelSource='Manta Ray Gas Pipeline' is correct and independently confirmed (see fills below) -- Manta Ray Offshore Gathering Company, L.L.C. is Nautilus's real upstream gathering system, itself a distinct FERC-recognized JV entity, and is a genuinely separate physical system from Nautilus, not a mislabel. Minor non-material note: GEM's EndLocation reads 'Neptune Gas Processing Plant, St. Mary's Parish' while the 1996-97 FERC filings name the same facility 'Exxon U.S.A. Inc.'s Garden City Gas Processing Plant' in St. Mary Parish -- parish and state agree across both eras; this reads as the same physical plant renamed/rebranded over ~30 years (consistent with the 'Neptune Pipeline Company, L.L.C.' holding-company name that emerged for this JV), not a location error. Opened/checked 3 of the 4 wiki-harvested citations for this row: the infopost.enbridge.com LINK portal (confirms 'Nautilus Pipeline Company, L.L.C.' as a live FERC pipe-code entity, code NPC) and the Enbridge factsheet PDF were live; the cited Genesis Energy 8-K PDF (wp-content/uploads/8K-07-16-2015-1.pdf) 404s, but the underlying 2015-07-16 Genesis/Enterprise 8-K filing itself is still live on SEC EDGAR under a different exhibit path and was used instead (see fills). The 4th harvested citation (abarrelfull.wikidot.com) was correctly NOT opened/cited -- banned source. The old 'Nautilus Gas Pipeline' Wikipedia article the wiki cited via a bit.ly link (accessed 2017) has since been merged/retitled to 'Nautilus Pipeline'; used the live retitled article instead.

validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's Owner1='Enbridge', Owner1%='100.00%' is contradicted by every independent source found, across a consistent 30-year paper trail: (1) FERC/DOE Federal Register notice, 61 FR 51440 (govinfo.gov, 1996-10-02) -- at formation, Nautilus's owners were Shell Seahorse Company (Shell Offshore affiliate) 50.00%, Marathon Gas Transmission Inc. (Marathon Oil affiliate) 24.33%, and Sailfish Pipeline Company, L.L.C. (Leviathan Gas Pipeline Partners subsidiary) 25.67% -- confirmed again verbatim in the follow-on FERC notice 62 FR 42114 (govinfo.gov, 1997-08-05). (2) Enbridge's own press release 'Enbridge Increases Interest in Nautilus...' (2005-10-03) states Enbridge acquired Marathon Gas Transmission's 24.33% interest in 'Neptune Pipeline Company, L.L.C., a holding company that owns the Nautilus gas transmission pipeline and the Manta Ray gathering pipeline system,' bringing Enbridge to 74.33% of Neptune, 'with Enterprise Products Partners continuing to hold the remainder' (25.67%) -- note: this specific press-release URL failed url_verifier's navigation-surface screen (mediaroom index.php?s=&item= pattern) so it is NOT included in proposed_refs, but its content is corroborated independently by items (3)-(5) below. (3) Genesis Energy LP 8-K exhibit filed 2015-07-16 (SEC EDGAR, part of Genesis's $1.5B acquisition of Enterprise's GoM offshore pipeline business) lists, in Enterprise's own Dec-31-2014 asset table: 'Nautilus System 25.7%(4) ... Our ownership interests in the Manta Ray Offshore Gathering System and the Nautilus System are held indirectly through our equity method investment in Neptune Pipeline Company, L.L.C.' (4) Genesis Energy LP 8-K exhibit filed 2026-02-24 (SEC EDGAR, an underwriting agreement) lists Nautilus, Manta Ray Offshore and Neptune as current 'Joint Venture Entities' and states the Partnership holds '25.67% of the equity interests in Neptune (which as of the date of this Agreement owns 100% of the equity interests in each of Nautilus and Manta Ray Offshore)' -- i.e. as of Feb 2026, Genesis Energy still holds its 25.67% Neptune stake, and Neptune (not Enbridge directly) is Nautilus's 100% direct parent. (5) Enbridge's own current 'Energy Infrastructure Assets' factsheet (last updated 2026-07-28) states plainly: 'Enbridge has a 74.33% ownership interest in the Nautilus Pipeline.' All five sources agree the non-Enbridge share is a real, live, ~25.67% stake (Sailfish/Leviathan in 1996-97 -> Enterprise Products by 2005-2015 -> Genesis Energy LP from 2015 to at least Feb 2026), never zero. GEM's Owner1=100% Enbridge appears to collapse the two-owner JV into the majority partner alone; this is a genuine, well-corroborated attribution error, not a rounding issue.

validity.recommendation: GEM's LengthKnown=154 km (96 mi) is the offshore-only portion. If LengthKnown is meant to reach the sheet's own recorded EndLocation (an onshore processing plant), update to 185 km (115 mi total = 96 mi/154 km offshore + 19 mi/31 km onshore) per Enbridge's current factsheet. At minimum, flag that GEM's figure excludes a documented onshore segment; do not silently keep 154 km as if it were the whole line.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM shows LengthKnown=154.00 km (=95.7 mi), which matches the OFFSHORE-only leg as currently broken out by Enbridge's own factsheet ('Length: 115 miles (185 km) -- 96 miles (154 km) offshore, 19 miles (31 km) onshore', factsheet last updated 2026-07-28). Every independent 'whole pipeline' length figure found, across 30 years, exceeds GEM's 96-mile/154-km value: 87 mi at first public announcement (Oil & Gas Journal, 1996-07-15, 'a 30 in. offshore line extending 87 miles from Ship Shoal Block 207 to gas processing plants...'); ~101 mi as FERC-certificated (Federal Register 61 FR 51440, 1996-10-02, and reaffirmed in 62 FR 42114, 1997-08-05: 'approximately 101 miles of 30-inch diameter pipeline'); 101 mi again in Enterprise Products' own Dec-31-2014 asset table (Genesis Energy 8-K exhibit, SEC EDGAR, filed 2015-07-16: 'Nautilus System ... 101' miles); 103 mi in Enbridge's 2005-10-03 press release ('extending 103 miles from a platform in the Ship Shoal Block 207... to the offshore Garden City area'); and 115 mi (96 offshore + 19 onshore) in Enbridge's current 2026 factsheet. GEM's own EndLocation for this row is 'Neptune Gas Processing Plant, St. Mary's Parish' -- an ONSHORE facility -- so a length meant to span Start-to-End should logically include the onshore leg, which every source but GEM's own figure does. This is corroborated by multiple independent, current, and historical primary/operator sources (not a single weak source), so I am flagging it as a spec concern rather than silently adding a ref that would appear to endorse the current, apparently incomplete, value.

gem.wiki's own (uncited-independently) claim is 'Operator: Neptune Pipeline Company, L.L.C.', but every independent source that discusses Neptune describes it consistently as a passive OWNERSHIP/holding vehicle, not an operator: Enbridge's 2005 press release calls Neptune 'a holding company that owns the Nautilus gas transmission pipeline and the Manta Ray gathering pipeline system'; Genesis Energy's 2026 SEC 8-K describes Genesis's stake as '25.67% of the equity interests in Neptune (which ... owns 100% of the equity interests in each of Nautilus and Manta Ray Offshore)' -- ownership language throughout, never 'operates'. No source found names a distinct day-to-day operating company (Enbridge itself is a plausible candidate given it is the majority owner and lists Nautilus among 'Enbridge's Energy Infrastructure Assets', and a general web search synthesis asserted 'Enbridge operates the Nautilus and Manta Ray pipelines', but I could not independently verify that specific operating-role claim against a primary source within this pass). Left UNRESOLVED rather than propagate what looks like wiki's own conflation of 'owns the holding company' with 'operates the pipeline'. Recommend checking PHMSA Form 7100 / NPMS operator-of-record data for Nautilus Pipeline Company, L.L.C., or FERC Form 2, for the actual operator-of-record name.

cross_row_leads.facts: Mississippi Canyon Pipeline: 30-in diameter, FERC-regulated offshore gas transmission pipeline, 44.5 mi (71.6 km) in the Mississippi Canyon Corridor, capacity 800 MMcf/d, status operational, transports gas to a processing plant in Venice, LA for delivery into three major pipelines -- exact match to the sheet's current len/dia/cap for P0217.

Garden Banks Pipeline: 30-in diameter, FERC-regulated offshore gas transmission pipeline, 50 mi (80 km) in the Garden Banks Corridor, capacity 1 Bcf/d (1000 MMcf/d), status operational, delivers into three major interstate pipelines offshore. Close match to sheet (len=84 km vs factsheet's 80 km; cap and dia match exactly).

Gulfstream Natural Gas: extends from southern Mobile County, AL across the GoM into Florida, length 745 mi (1,199 km) -- exact match to sheet's 1199 km; peak-day capacity 1.31 Bcf/d = 1310 MMcf/d -- exact match to sheet's 1310; status operational; ownership Enbridge 50% / Williams Partners, L.P. 50% (useful for filling P0199's currently-unsourced Owner cells).

Southeast Supply Header (SESH): 287-mi pipeline (462 km, matches sheet's 462 km exactly) from Perryville Hub, NE Louisiana to the Gulfstream system in Mobile County, AL; peak-day capacity 1.1 Bcf/d (sheet shows 1140 MMcf/d, a close but not exact match); ownership Enbridge 50% / Energy Transfer LP 50%; Operator: Enbridge (business and technical functions), Energy Transfer LP (field operations) -- useful for filling P0164's currently-unsourced Owner/Operator cells.

Destin Pipeline: 24-to-36-in diameter (matches sheet), total length 255 mi (410 km) = 120 mi (193 km) offshore + 135 mi (217 km) onshore in Mississippi -- sheet currently shows 385 km, a ~6% discrepancy worth checking; capacity 1.2 Bcf/d = 1200 MMcf/d, exact match to sheet; Enbridge holds a 33% interest, operated by joint-venture partner Third Coast Midstream (useful for P0175's Owner/Operator cells).

summary: P0223 Nautilus Gas Pipeline is real, current (a live JV entity per a Feb-2026 SEC filing) and correctly classified as a FERC-jurisdictional offshore gas transmission line; confirmed Status/Fuel/StartYear/Capacity/Diameter/FuelSource/Location and filled Proposal(1996)/Construction(1997)/SegmentCost($121M,1996) -- but Owner1='Enbridge 100%' is a confirmed attribution error (should split ~74.33% Enbridge / ~25.67% Genesis Energy LP, both via Neptune Pipeline Company LLC) and LengthKnown=154km appears to be an offshore-only figure missing a documented 31km/19mi onshore leg (should likely be 185km/115mi total) -- both flagged as concerns, not silently passed. Pressure and Operator left UNRESOLVED (no source found for MAOP; Operator ambiguous -- wiki's 'Neptune Pipeline Company' claim looks like a mislabeled owner, not a real operator-of-record).
